decisions.reason: Locates 42 session.events reads (channel.js:734 etc.), maps the not-iterable TypeError to the removed property, cites the alpha.4 changelog with seq/eventAt/snapshotEvents replacements, and explains the undefined access.
Shows alpha.5 satisfies ^0.1.2-alpha.2 via correct prerelease-aware desugaring, states npm checks only version strings not API existence, and frames the peer declaration as an untested author claim.
Gives seven genuinely distinct classes (removed API, changed signature/arity, changed semantics, return-shape change, event changes, error behavior, resolution mismatch), each explained.

Requires CI testing of actual target versions including range top/prereleases, plus a compatibility policy: tightened peer range and a runtime feature-detection guard/dual-shape adapter; distinguishes metadata claims (peer range, engines) from runtime guards.

Concrete pre-install check: diff the changelog across the peer range span and grep the plugin source for session.events against the installed version, both tied to this incident; explicitly rejects mere range re-checking.

caps.reason: Conclusions affirm the opposite: satisfied peer range proves nothing about runtime API compatibility; Session.events removal is affirmed.
